title: Fixed-arity whole-word expression notation: exact prior and a boundary obstruction
ownership: Root proposed revisiting fixed-arity expression trees. The producer located IP080 and distinguished later source-specific implementations. Root and producer separately articulated the same elementary boundary obstruction before applying old evidence; this is shared reasoning, not an independent blinded result.

exact_existing_idea.already_proposed: A complete prefix expression starts with one pending expression slot; an arity-k operator consumes one and opens k. Pending slots must stay positive until the last word and then reach zero. Competing serial expressions and natural language were already identified as alternatives.
exact_existing_idea.explicit_limit: The original card says operator arities and complete-expression boundaries must not both be learned from the same successful cases. Inherited parser roles are not semantic gold.
exact_existing_idea.registry_status: Curated untested, proposal_only, with not_reviewed and unmotivated_model blockers. This metadata does not prove an unexecuted generic experiment, novelty, or readiness.
exact_existing_idea.review_meaning: Excluded from a semantic-only list because it is a structural proposal, not experimentally refuted. The translation-program predecessor screen lists it as a lexical navigation candidate for several programs, not as an identical executed design.

narrow_contract_under_discussion.units: Every complete visible output word is one node in an ordered rooted expression tree. Its exact whole form has one fixed nonnegative integer arity globally within a reader's account. No sign, word meaning or particular arity is assigned here.
narrow_contract_under_discussion.scope: Each independently fixed source-marked paragraph is exactly one complete tree, in one globally fixed prefix or postfix traversal. No ignored words, silent roots, omitted arguments, extra sentence expressions, context-dependent arities, visible-word splitting or paragraph-dependent mode changes are allowed.
narrow_contract_under_discussion.scope_status: This is an explicit candidate assumption, not a recovered native sentence boundary. Source paragraph flags are annotation and may disagree between readers.
narrow_contract_under_discussion.quantifier_difference: IP080 proposed testing motivated, specified operators. A universal necessary feasibility question can instead quantify over every global whole-form arity assignment while fixing the scope beforehand. Failure would then reject all assignments under that scope, without identifying any operator; success would remain weak structural compatibility. It is not a new complete writing system.

mathematical_conditions.total: For n words w1..wn with arities a(wi), sum_i(1-a(wi))=1. A tree has n-1 edges, counted once among all child slots.
mathematical_conditions.prefix: H0=1; Hk=H(k-1)-1+a(wk). Require Hk>0 for every proper prefix k<n and Hn=0. For known arities these conditions reconstruct one ordered tree, but not its semantics or type correctness.
mathematical_conditions.postfix: S0=0; before each word require S(k-1)>=a(wk); then Sk=S(k-1)-a(wk)+1. Require Sn=1. Equivalently, every nonempty prefix has Sk>=1 and the final value is1. The popped argument order is a paid convention.
mathematical_conditions.forest_limit: If a paragraph is allowed to contain m separate complete expressions, the total becomes m, not1. Choosing m after a failed one-tree check changes the contract. Unrestricted forests permit the trivial all-arity0 reading of any sequence and cannot by themselves identify a useful grammar.
mathematical_conditions.counterexample_to_total_alone: With a(A)=0 and a(F)=1, the sequence A F satisfies the total equation but is not one prefix tree: A closes the tree before F. It is a legal postfix tree. Direction and prefix/stack inequalities matter.
mathematical_conditions.repetition_limit: AAA inside a larger tree is not generally forbidden. For example a(F)=1,a(A)=0 gives legal prefix F F F A and legal postfix A F F F. Known whole-word triples alone cannot refute this unrestricted arity class. A complete expression consisting solely of AAA would be impossible because3*(1-a(A)) cannot equal1; treating a local triple as such an entire expression would need independent scope evidence.

boundary_obstruction.lemma: In a complete prefix tree with at least two nodes, the first node has positive arity and the last node has arity0. In a complete postfix tree the first node has arity0 and the last node has positive arity.
boundary_obstruction.proof: A multi-node tree's root has a child and therefore positive arity. The final preorder node and initial postorder node have no children because any child would respectively occur afterward or beforehand. Those nodes are leaves.
boundary_obstruction.consequence: The same exact whole form occurring as the first word of one complete multiword paragraph and the last word of another complete multiword paragraph cannot have a globally fixed arity under either traversal. No arity ceiling, lexicon, glyph mapping, operator meaning, optimization or parser implementation is needed.
boundary_obstruction.asymmetric_minimum: For prefix, a multiword first-position witness plus any complete last-position witness suffices, even if that second paragraph has one word. For postfix, any complete first-position witness plus a multiword last-position witness suffices. This matters when only aggregate boundary evidence is available.

human_construction_limit: A learned prefix/postfix vocabulary can carry meaningful open statements, but readers must learn each lexeme's meaning, arity, argument order and types. Names require a paid literal node/quoting convention; punctuation, sentence combinations, source-word boundaries and overwide output groups require a physical carrier. An arity assignment or balanced tree alone pays none of those costs. No new22-sign construction is supplied or needed for the boundary lemma.

disposition: No new raw card and no general solver. Retain IP080 as the existing broader unselected architecture. On the supplied old IT2a edge evidence and root's existing profile check, both globally fixed traversal directions are conditionally contradicted for this explicitly declared one-paragraph-one-tree, one-whole-form-one-arity contract. No invisible null nodes, implicit arguments or multiple roots were allowed. Root owns recording that narrow closure. It is not a rejection of expression notation, learned open language, natural grammar, all readers or any proposed word meaning.
